findings.issue: prepare_runner.py prepare refuses every official Linux/macOS runner archive because the archive contains relative symlinks under externals/node*/bin/ and line 81 rejects any tar member that is not a directory or regular file; the documented receipted preparation path (.preparation.json, inspect, interrupted-state resume) is therefore unreachable on real input.
findings.scenario: Operator follows references/setup.md:18-24 with actions-runner-osx-arm64-2.338.0.tar.gz and its published digest df4cebda25c86a886ed204e49fee63f5c2e7cec5f447b5c98440a826bbdf9df2; the helper exits 1 with 'Archive links and special entries require manual review'. tar census of the archive: 9390 files, 2152 dirs, 6 symlinks (externals/node24 and node20 bin/{npm,npx,corepack} -> ../lib/node_modules/...). Tests use only two-file synthetic fixtures.
findings.recommended_direction: Accept symlink members whose target is relative, does not escape the instance directory and resolves inside it (create after regular files, or materialize), keep refusing absolute/escaping links and hardlinks; add an official-layout fixture with such symlinks to tests/test_prepare_runner.py; update references/setup.md:26 and README.md:38.

Writer side verified at source level (actions/runner@main), not against a live registration (BLOCKED).
findings.scenario: Scenario B (tests/scenarios.md:15): agent runs inspect --directory <instance> per discovery.md:27 / verification.md:21. With a byte-exact fixture printf '\xef\xbb\xbf{"agentId":42,"agentName":"box","gitHubUrl":"https://github.com/acme/widget"}' > .runner, the helper exits 1 with 'Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig)'. Same bytes without BOM succeed. Existing test writes its fixture with json.dumps and never sees the real format.
findings.recommended_direction: Read state files with encoding='utf-8-sig'; tolerate a missing/non-string gitHubUrl without a traceback (today a non-string value reaches urlsplit and escapes the except at line 154); add a BOM-prefixed .runner fixture to tests/test_prepare_runner.py.

findings.issue: select_runner.py collapses forced/untrusted events, every missing or invalid configuration value, malformed RUNNER_LABELS, HTTP/JSON errors (including 401 from an expired RUNNER_READ_TOKEN) and 'no idle match' into one silent hosted fallback; the only job output is runner=<label>, so a broken configuration or expired PAT is indistinguishable from an intentional fallback.
findings.scenario: Operator sets TRUSTED_RUNNER_REF=main instead of refs/heads/main; TRUSTED_EVENT is 'false' on every push, select() returns the fallback at line 64 with no API call and no message; CI silently runs hosted forever. Likewise when the finite-expiry PAT expires (401 swallowed at lines 90-93).
findings.recommended_direction: Return (label, reason) with a fixed non-secret vocabulary (forced, untrusted_event, missing_config, invalid_label, api_error, no_match, selected); write it as a second GITHUB_OUTPUT line and a ::notice:: on stdout; never include exception text; assert the reason in test_skips_api and test_api_error_and_custom_fallback; document it in references/ci.md:31.

findings.issue: platforms.md:54 and the renderer's --path/EnvironmentVariables.PATH present the plist PATH as the service PATH, and ci.md:3 says services do not inherit interactive PATH; but config.sh:74 sources env.sh, env.sh:37 writes `echo $PATH>.path`, and bin/runsvc.sh (the plist entry point, WorkingDirectory = runner dir) exports PATH from .path when present, overriding the plist value with the PATH of the shell that ran config.sh.
findings.scenario: Operator renders the plist with the default or a 'verified controlled' --path, registers from an interactive shell whose PATH starts with /opt/homebrew/bin or a user-writable directory; the daemon runs with that PATH, not the rendered one. Conversely an operator adding Homebrew via --path sees no effect. Verified against actions/runner@main runsvc.sh/env.sh and config.sh from the 2.338.0 archive.
findings.recommended_direction: Document .path/.env precedence in references/platforms.md and references/ci.md:3; make the rendered plan (macos_service.py:49-91) instruct the operator to inspect/set .path as the runtime account; either drop --path or state it applies only when .path is absent.

findings.issue: github-runner/README.md documents `npx skills add diegomarino/my-skills --skill github-runner` ('after this skill is published') while the root README (lines 10-11, unchanged) and both sibling skill READMEs document `npx skills add diegomarino/my-skills@<skill>` with a `-g` variant; two different install contracts for the same action.
findings.scenario: A reader of the root table row the diff adds follows the root install form; a reader of the skill README follows a different form; whether both CLI forms work was not verified (would download the CLI).
findings.recommended_direction: Use the @github-runner form and the -g variant to match the root README; keep the local `npx skills add . --list` discovery line if desired.
